epic_cosmos.name: Epic Cosmos
epic_cosmos.description: Epic Cosmos is a collaborative research platform containing de-identified patient data from over 300 million patients across more than 1,600 hospitals and health systems using Epic electronic health record systems. Data is accessed via SlicerDicer, a self-service analytics tool. The dataset includes emergency department visits, diagnoses, immunizations, laboratory results, and other clinical data. Due to privacy protections, counts fewer than 10 are suppressed and imputed. Coverage extends across all U.S. states and territories. Note that county-level and city-level stratifications could differ markedly in total sample size due to high levels of missingness of county data in some states.
epic_cosmos.restrictions: The data can be re-used with appropriate attribution. A suggested citation relating to this data is 'Results of research performed with Epic Cosmos were obtained from the PopHIVE platform (https://github.com/PopHIVE/Ingest).'

epic_n_strep_throat.long_name: Patients with a Strep Throat Diagnosis
epic_n_strep_throat.short_description: Quarterly count of patients with a strep throat diagnosis (J02.0, J03.00, J03.01).
epic_n_strep_throat.long_description: Quarterly count of patients with a strep throat diagnosis, including streptococcal pharyngitis (J02.0), acute streptococcal tonsillitis, unspecified (J03.00), and acute recurrent streptococcal tonsillitis (J03.01). Data from Epic Cosmos, which contains de-identified data from 300M+ patients across 1,600+ hospitals. Counts of 10 or fewer are suppressed by Epic and imputed as 5; see epic_strep_throat_suppressed_flag. Quarters only partially covered by the exported date range are dropped, so every value covers a full calendar quarter. Population base per SlicerDicer session 2809857: data model Patients, population base All Patients, criteria Country of Care = United States of America and Has Any Encounters - the denominator is all patients with any encounter, NOT emergency department visits only.
epic_n_strep_throat.statement: In {location}, {value} patients had a strep throat diagnosis.

epic_pct_strep_throat.long_name: Percent of Patients with a Strep Throat Diagnosis
epic_pct_strep_throat.short_description: Quarterly percent of patients with a strep throat diagnosis (J02.0, J03.00, J03.01).
epic_pct_strep_throat.long_description: Quarterly percentage of patients with a strep throat diagnosis, computed as epic_n_strep_throat / epic_n_patients * 100. Diagnosis codes include streptococcal pharyngitis (J02.0), acute streptococcal tonsillitis, unspecified (J03.00), and acute recurrent streptococcal tonsillitis (J03.01). Where the numerator was suppressed it is imputed as 5 before the percentage is computed. Where the denominator was itself suppressed the percentage is left missing, because dividing by the imputed denominator of 5 would assert a meaningless value; those cells are marked by epic_n_patients_suppressed_flag. Data from Epic Cosmos SlicerDicer. Population base per SlicerDicer session 2809857: data model Patients, population base All Patients, criteria Country of Care = United States of America and Has Any Encounters - the denominator is all patients with any encounter, NOT emergency department visits only.
epic_pct_strep_throat.statement: In {location}, {value}% of patients had a strep throat diagnosis.

epic_strep_throat_suppressed_flag.long_name: Suppression flag for the strep throat numerator (count and percent)
epic_strep_throat_suppressed_flag.short_description: Indicates whether the strep throat numerator was suppressed and imputed; applies to both epic_n_strep_throat and epic_pct_strep_throat.
epic_strep_throat_suppressed_flag.long_description: 1 when Epic Cosmos suppressed the strep throat cell (a count of 10 or fewer, reported as "10 or fewer" or left blank) and epic_n_strep_throat was imputed as 5; 0 otherwise. The flag is computed before imputation, so it records what the source withheld rather than what the ingest wrote. It covers epic_pct_strep_throat as well, because the percentage is derived from this same numerator cell. Suppression of the denominator is tracked separately by epic_n_patients_suppressed_flag; a reader wanting to know whether the percentage was affected by suppression at all takes the OR of the two flags.

epic_n_patients.short_description: Quarterly total patient count used as the denominator for the strep throat percentage.
epic_n_patients.long_description: Quarterly total count of patients, used as the denominator for epic_pct_strep_throat. Data from Epic Cosmos SlicerDicer. Counts of 10 or fewer are suppressed by Epic and imputed as 5; see epic_n_patients_suppressed_flag. Population base per SlicerDicer session 2809857: data model Patients, population base All Patients, criteria Country of Care = United States of America and Has Any Encounters - the denominator is all patients with any encounter, NOT emergency department visits only.

epic_n_patients_suppressed_flag.long_name: Suppression flag for the total patient count
epic_n_patients_suppressed_flag.short_description: Indicates whether the total patient count was suppressed and imputed.
epic_n_patients_suppressed_flag.long_description: 1 when Epic Cosmos suppressed the denominator cell (a count of 10 or fewer, reported as "10 or fewer" or left blank) and epic_n_patients was imputed as 5; 0 otherwise. Where this flag is 1, epic_pct_strep_throat is left missing rather than computed from an imputed denominator.

_catalog.name: Epic Cosmos Respiratory Infections
_catalog.summary: Emergency department visits due to respiratory infections, including RSV, pneumonia, Group A Strep, COVID-19, and influenza. Data are obtained from Epic Cosmos, a collaborative research platform containing de-identified patient data from hospitals and health systems using Epic electronic health record systems.
